preprocess_skill_content: preprocess SKILL.md content by substituting template variables and expanding inline shell snippets
substitute_template_vars: substitute HERMES_SKILL_DIR and HERMES_SESSION_ID template tokens in skill markdown content
expand_inline_shell: expand inline shell snippets in skill content by executing commands and replacing with output
run_inline_shell: run a single bash command and return its stdout with error handling and output truncation
load_skills_config: load the skills section from config.yaml and return it as a dictionary
